error.invalid_position_mapping: Enter at least one temperature difference, each mapped to a cover position from 0 (closed) to 100 (open).
error.invalid_outdoor_adjustment: Enter at least one outdoor temperature, each mapped to an adjustment from -100 to 100.
error.invalid_temperature_range: Minimum temperature must be lower than maximum temperature.
error.same_temperature_sensor: The outdoor sensor must be a different entity from the indoor sensor.

user.description: 0% keeps the boiler and radiator loops separate. 100% joins them into one loop. The command is never sent above the maximum position; 100 disables that limit.

data_description.temperature_sensor_entity_id: Indoor temperature, in the living space rather than on the boiler.
data_description.max_position: Safety ceiling. The valve is never commanded above this. 100 disables the limit.
data_description.precision: Display precision of the current temperature, usually 0.1 or 1.
data_description.cover_entity_id: Cover entity that moves the valve. Position 0 is closed and 100 is open.
data_description.additional_cover_entity_ids: Other covers in the same room. They receive the same position as the main cover.
data_description.min_cycle_duration: Minimum time between automatic moves. Changes of mode, preset, or target temperature apply immediately. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.emergency_position: Position used when the indoor sensor is unavailable, unknown, or not numeric. Outdoor trim and the maximum position still apply.
data_description.min_temp_change_step: Ignore room-temperature changes smaller than this since the last move. 0 updates on every change. Mode, preset, and target changes still apply immediately.
data_description.position_tolerance: Do not send a new position when the cover is already within this many percent of the target.

outdoor.title: Outdoor temperature
outdoor.description: Outdoor temperature is added to the indoor position. A negative adjustment closes the mixing valve on a mild day. Leave the sensor empty to use the indoor map only. The result is still kept at or below the maximum position.

data_description.outdoor_adjustment_mapping: Keys are outdoor °C. Values are percent points added to the indoor position, from -100 to 100. A key applies from that temperature up to the next warmer key.

valve_position.title: Valve position mapping
valve_position.description: Keys are target minus current temperature, rounded to 0.1 °C. Values are cover positions from 0 (closed) to 100 (open). A value applies when the difference is greater than its key, up to and including the next key.

data_description.position_mapping: Default opening for each indoor temperature difference. Adjust it after the valve has run for a while.

data_description.min_temp: Lowest target temperature that can be set.
data_description.max_temp: Highest target temperature that can be set.
data_description.target_temp_step: Step used when changing the target temperature.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Manual is always available. It holds the valve at the Manual position and ignores the temperature maps. Leave another preset empty to hide it.
